title: Embedded Core Run Correspondence
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet, let $y$ be a finite Boolean input word, let $c$ be a configuration of the deterministic simulation core for $N$ on $y$, and let $t$ be a natural number. Running the pair-loader machine for $t$ steps from the configuration obtained by embedding the core state into the pair-loader state space gives exactly the embedded configuration reached by running the core for $t$ steps from $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a nondeterministic Turing machine over the binary alphabet
$c$ is a core configuration on input $y$
replaced: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic machine over the binary alphabet and let $d$ be any configuration of the simulation core of $N$. For every step count $t$, running the pair-loader machine of $N$ for $t$ steps from the state-renamed copy of $d$ yields exactly the state-renamed copy of the $t$-step run of the simulation core from $d$.
